job: Put an icon, prefix, unit or button inside one field.
purpose: One field with affixes: the group carries the single hairline and focus halo, and a bare fd-input lives inside it. Affixes are an icon, a text prefix, a unit, a chevron or a small ghost button one step below the field size. The same group holds the input of a combobox.
useWhen: A fixed part of a URL, a currency or a unit sits beside the value (https://, USD, ms).
A button belongs to the value inside the field: copy, show, apply.
An icon or a chevron marks what the field is.

avoidWhen.when: The field and a button are two separate actions side by side.
The field is a search with a clear button.
The value is a number with steppers.
The field picks from a list.

states.name: entry
states.how: data-mode="entry" on a secret group; see secret

variants.useWhen: A chip prefix or suffix for the part of a URL people should not retype.
A plain muted prefix or suffix such as https://.
A unit in mono after a number: ms, MB, requests.
A ghost button inside the field.
A chevron that opens a list; used by the combobox.
A short value; the width follows the input's size attribute.

parts.role: An icon, text, unit, chevron or button at either end.
